program:
app "Growth" chart mint
state pay money = 5000
state rate num = 10
state years num = 15
field pay "Saving each month"
"Yearly return %" rate faint
slider rate 0..30
"Years" years faint
slider years 1..30
let fv(y num) = if(rate = 0, pay * 12 * y, pay * (pow(1 + rate / 1200, 12 * y) - 1) / (rate / 1200))
"After" years "years" faint
(fv(years)) big
"You put in" (pay * 12 * years) faint
plot 0..years, 0..fv(years) axes
  each 1..years
    rect index + 0.15, 0, 0.7, fv(it) fill accent radius 2
    tick index + 0.5, it
describe:
Growth, in the mint colours.
Remembers while you use it: pay, starting at 5000; rate, starting at 10; years, starting at 15.
Shows:
- a box to fill in pay, labelled "Saving each month".
- text: "Yearly return %", rate.
- a slider for rate from 0 to 30.
- text: "Years", years.
- a slider for years from 1 to 30.
- text: "After", years, "years".
- text: pay times 12 times years when rate is 0, otherwise pay times the result of the pow of 1 plus rate divided by 1200 minus 1 divided by the result of rate divided by 1200.
- text: "You put in", the result of pay times 12 times years.

program:
app "Pregnancy" baby plum
setting due date "Due date"
table kick
let wk = clamp(floor((280 - (due - today)) / 7), 0, 40)
screen week "Week" baby
  goal wk, 40, "weeks along"
  "Days to go" due - today big
  "Trimester" if(wk < 13, 1, if(wk < 27, 2, 3)) faint
screen kicks "Kicks" heart
  count(kick today) "kicks today" big
  button "Baby kicked" tap add kick
  daybars last 7 days, count(kick on it)
describe:
Pregnancy, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- kick: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Due date": date.
Works out:
- wk is the result of 280 minus the result of due minus today divided by 7 rounded down kept between 0 and 40.
Shows:
- a screen "Week":
  - wk out of 40 with a progress bar, labelled "weeks along".
  - text: "Days to go", due minus today.
  - text: "Trimester", 1 when wk is less than 13, otherwise 2 when wk is less than 27, otherwise 3.
- a screen "Kicks":
  - text: how many kick entries today, "kicks today".
  - a button "Baby kicked"; a tap adds a kick.
  - a bar chart of how many kick entries on that day for each day in the last 7 days.

program:
app "Healthy eating" apple slate
table rule name text
table rule_done rule ref rule
let n = count(rule)
count(rule_done today) "of" n "done today" head
each rule
  row card gap 2 tap edit it swipe remove it
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      streak(it.rule_done) "day streak" faint
    toggle it.rule_done
form rule
stat round(count(rule_done week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% done this week"
heat last 70 days, count(rule_done on it), n
remind "Time to tick off food rules" every 3h from 8:00 to 20:00
describe:
Healthy eating, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- rule: name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- rule done: rule: a rule. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- n is how many rule entries.
Shows:
- text: how many rule done entries today, "of", n, "done today".
- for each rule:
  - a group; a tap opens the rule for editing; a swipe removes the rule, with undo:
    - text: its name.
    - text: the current day streak of its rule done entries, "day streak".
    - a tick box for its rule done.
- a form to add a rule.
- a big number: how many rule done entries this week times 100 divided by the result of n times the weekday number of today rounded, labelled "% done this week".
- a heat map of how many rule done entries on that day for each day in the last 70 days.
Reminder "Time to tick off food rules" every 3 hours from 8:00 to 20:00.

program:
app "Garden jobs" plant ink
table garden_job title text, done bool, due date?
count(garden_job where done = no) "open" head
each garden_job where done = no sort due as t
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    toggle t.done
    stack grow
      t.title bold
      t.due small color if(t.due < today, bad, muted)
form garden_job
"Done" faint
list garden_job where done = yes
button "Clear done" tap remove all garden_job where done = yes
remind "Check your garden jobs" at 8:00
describe:
Garden jobs, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- garden job: title: text; done: yes or no; due: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: how many garden job entries where done is no, "open".
- for each garden job where done is no sorted by due:
  - a group; a tap opens the garden job for editing; a swipe removes the garden job, with undo:
    - a tick box for the done of the garden job.
    - text: the title of the garden job.
    - text: the due of the garden job.
- a form to add a garden job.
- text: "Done".
- a list of garden job where done is yes; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
- a button "Clear done"; a tap removes all garden job entries where done is yes, with one undo.
Reminder "Check your garden jobs" at 8:00 every day.

program:
app "Focus" timer ink
table session task text, kind pick Work|Break = Work
setting work dur = 25m "Work length"
setting rest dur = 5m "Break length"
state cur text = ""
field cur "What are you working on?"
timer work, "Work", add session task = cur, kind = Work then notify "Work done. Take a break"
timer rest, "Break", add session task = Break, kind = Break then notify "Break over"
count(session today where kind = Work) "work sessions today" head
"Focus time today:" count(session today where kind = Work) * work / 1m "min" faint
daybars last 7 days, count(session on it where kind = Work)
list session where kind = Work by day
describe:
Focus, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- session: task: text; kind: one of Work, Break, starts at Work. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Work length": length of time, starts at 25 minutes; "Break length": length of time, starts at 5 minutes.
Remembers while you use it: cur, starting at "".
Shows:
- a box to fill in cur, labelled "What are you working on?".
- a countdown timer of work, labelled "Work"; when it ends it adds a session with task set to cur, kind set to Work, then shows the notice "Work done. Take a break".
- a countdown timer of rest, labelled "Break"; when it ends it adds a session with task set to Break, kind set to Break, then shows the notice "Break over".
- text: how many session entries today where kind is Work, "work sessions today".
- text: "Focus time today:", how many session entries today where kind is Work times work divided by 1 minute, "min".
- a bar chart of how many session entries on that day where kind is Work for each day in the last 7 days.
- a list of session where kind is Work by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
